messages:
ben_sales: Hey team — kicking off a quick presales POC with NovaRetail. They need streaming + function/tool calls + structured order JSON output. Main constraints: ephemeral creds, on-prem proxy, and field-level encryption. Any quick runbook we can share?
priya_se: Quick Q — what's expected qps and average sequence length? that drives batching/latency tradeoffs.
ben_sales: Peak ~50 qps, steady ~10 qps, avg seq ~300 tokens. They also said bursts to 150 qps during promos.
alyssa_prod: For ephemeral creds we usually do a short-lived session token flow. Example handshake: ```POST /v1/sessions {"client_id":"<id>", "expires_in":300}``` return is JWT tied to allowlisted IP. Works well with on-prem proxies.
priya_se: For streaming + toolcalls: send `response_mode: streaming` and include `tools` schema in the request. Tool responses stream as event messages — ensure client supports partial JSON assembly.
ben_sales: Customer asked about latency impact when we enable continuous batching + KV cache. Any ballpark numbers we can quote?
alyssa_prod: Ballpark on Dedicated (1xA100) with continuous batching: p50 ~60–90ms, p95 ~180–300ms for 300-token flows. Turn down batch window (eg 5ms) for lower tail latency but cost up. KV caching cuts token cost for repeated prefixes dramatically.
priya_se: Security side: they want SOC2 mapping + KMS. We can offer Private deployment (VPC) with customer-managed KMS/HSM and audit logs. Also provide data residency in EU if needed.
ben_sales: Pricing question — they want reserved pricing + burst. Recommended commitment size?
alyssa_prod: Suggest a 3-month pilot with 20% reserved commit and a burst pool for promos. We can tier the reserved GPUs and offer step-up after pilot. I'll draft numbers.
infra-bot: runbook-uploaded: https://redwood.internal/poc/nova-retail/runbook.pdf (contains handshake, token rotation, ip allowlist, load-script). Please review @ben_sales :white_check_mark:
ben_sales: Perfect — can SRE get a one-page test checklist we can hand to the customer?
priya_se: On it — will post a checklist in channel in ~15m. items: handshake, ephemeral token rotation test, streaming func-call echo test, structured JSON validation, load script for peak bursts.
ben_sales: Thanks all. Flagging legal to complete the security questionnaire and looping in solutions architect if they want architecture review. :thumbsup:
